bullets.text: Chennai drone company Zuppa Geo Navigation Technologies plans to raise up to $10 million in equity funding to expand its technology centre and engineering team.
The office should monitor Zuppa's funding progress and offer support for expanding its drone technology development operations in Chennai.

stories.title: Zuppa eyes $10 million funding as it looks to scale domestic and international business
